name: 阿宝
desc: Alipay's AI front door, a dialog entry to every service
desc_zh: 支付宝的 AI 版入口，一个对话框直达上万种服务
solves: Finding one rare service in Alipay means hunting through mini-programs. Ah Bao takes the sentence and opens the right page.
solves_zh: 一年用一次的服务，每次都要在小程序里翻半天。说一句话，它直接把办事入口送到你面前。
best_for: You need to pay a utility bill and cannot remember which mini-program does it.
best_for_zh: 要交一笔水电费，却忘了该进哪个小程序的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.antgroup.com/news-media/press-releases (newsroom index) and http）。 The AI edition of Alipay, named 阿宝 (Ah Bao), reached users through an invitation test on 2026-06-16 and the original Alipay UI stays available side by side. It is an in-product surface of 支付宝, not a separate download: the newsroom page is the only first-party surface found and its body is JavaScript-rendered, so the quote was read through a rendering page reader rather than plain curl. The release also promises a future Agent 开放平台 for developers, merchants and service providers; no dated first-party page for that platform was read. Relation to the ledger: 灵光 (2025-11-18) is Ant's standalone multimodal assistant, AQ (2025-06-26) its health app; 阿宝 is neither. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.antgroup.com/news-media/press-releases/1781596800000
